dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-toned perimeters forming closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes; the boundary exhibits a high-contrast transition from the dark-gray exterior background to a textured light-gray/white perimeter border enclosing a dark-gray interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid light-toned pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized in the anterior-dorsal region and interspersed between the larger ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle, with the longest side extending from the anterior-most 'C' shape to the posterior-ventral 'O' ring.
